globalStyle: SNES 16-bit pixel art combat effect animation, limited color palette, chunky clean pixels, retro tactical RPG visual effect, glowing energy on a solid pure black background

combat_fx_sig.stylePrefix: sprite sheet of exactly 8 animation frames arranged in a 4x2 grid with 4 columns and 2 rows, frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom showing the effect build up, reach maximum intensity, and dissipate, each frame centered in its cell, solid pure black background, no grid lines, no borders, no text
